scene_purpose: Make the invisible force visually understandable: a pressure wave tearing through the canopy.
main_subject: A wall of dust and debris sweeping left-to-right across a conifer forest; trees bending and snapping in one coherent direction.

camera.angle: Wide shot from an elevated slope looking across the forest, wave front on a diagonal
camera.composition: Already-fallen trunks in the foreground point along the wave direction; standing forest mid-frame bends away; dust wall fills the upper-left; untouched hazy forest upper-right shows what is about to be lost.

lighting.direction: Sunlight from upper right, heavily diffused through the dust wall
lighting.intensity_and_character: Warm dusty backscatter inside the wave; neutral daylight outside it; strong directional coherence sells the physics.

foreground_elements: freshly fallen trunks with torn root plates
midground_elements: rank of trees mid-bend at varying angles (coherent direction)
environmental_details: all motion vectors agree with one wave direction
bend angle increases toward the wave front
atmospheric_effects: haze gradient from chaos to calm
animation_opportunities: THE key engine moment: fallState(R) radius sweep drives per-instance fall, exactly s4_shockwave.js
dust front particles advancing with the radius
must_preserve: directional coherence of every falling tree
sense of speed via streaked debris
can_simplify: dust wall to large soft sprite billboards moving with R
splinter detail to the stripped coniferGeometry variant

engine_mapping.wave: scenes/lib/world.js fallState(R, softness) with R(t) expanding from EPI; makeForest update(stateFn) sets fall 0->1 and dir away from epicentre — the exact s4_shockwave.js mechanism
engine_mapping.trees: geometry: geo.living + swap to coniferGeometry({stripped:true}) behind the front
engine_mapping.dust: particles({ n: 4000, box: wide, size: 1.2, color: '#b8a88e', opacity: 0.35, drift: high }) clustered at radius R
engine_mapping.camera: fov ~40, elevated, slight roll/shake driven by wave proximity
